what_is_it.explanation: Canvas UI is a framework-agnostic component library that provides creative canvas effects like fluid simulations, fire, glass, and 3D scenes running over live interactive HTML interfaces. It supports multiple frameworks and offers copy-paste components via a shadcn-compatible registry. Components can render using WebGL with GLSL or WebGPU through vgpu with WGSL.
what_is_it.one_line: A library of creative canvas components offering real HTML with WebGL and WebGPU effects running over it.
